lines.cap: Every July, the most powerful men in America put on robes, and burn a body in front of a giant owl.
lines.say: Every July, the most powerful men in America put on robes, and burn a body in front of a giant owl.

lines.cap: This isn't a horror film. It's a private camp, hidden in the California redwoods. Bohemian Grove.
lines.say: This isn't a horror film. It's a private camp, hidden in the California redwoods. Bohemian Grove.

lines.cap: Presidents have been members or guests. Hoover. Nixon. Reagan. Plus bankers, generals and the bosses of giant companies.
lines.say: Presidents have been members or guests. Hoover. Nixon. Reagan. Plus bankers, generals and the bosses of giant companies.

lines.cap: No women. No cameras. And their motto: weaving spiders come not here. Meaning, no business. Officially.
lines.say: No women. No cameras. And their motto: weaving spiders come not here. Meaning, no business. Officially.

lines.cap: On the first night, they hold a ceremony called the Cremation of Care.
lines.say: On the first night, they hold a ceremony called the Cremation of Care.

lines.cap: Men in hooded red robes carry a body to the feet of a forty foot stone owl.
lines.say: Men in hooded red robes carry a body to the feet of a forty foot stone owl.

lines.cap: And they set it on fire.
lines.say: And they set it on fire.

lines.cap: The body is a dummy. It stands for their worries. They burn their cares away, then party for two weeks.
lines.say: The body is a dummy. It stands for their worries. They burn their cares away, then party for two weeks.

lines.cap: In 2000, an outsider sneaked in with a hidden camera, and filmed the whole thing.
lines.say: In 2000, an outsider sneaked in with a hidden camera, and filmed the whole thing.

lines.cap: But the creepiest part? In 1942, scientists met at the Grove to plan the atomic bomb.
lines.say: But the creepiest part? In 1942, scientists met at the Grove to plan the atomic bomb.

lines.cap: So the next time the owl burns, ask yourself, what else gets decided in those woods?
lines.say: So the next time the owl burns, ask yourself, what else gets decided in those woods?
